'''Voss''' was the [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. [[Tala-Reh]] felt that, compared to the Voss language, [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] lacked nuance.<ref>[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]</ref>
